case_title: LANGFORD LAND SURVEYING VS. TELEGRAPH HILL PROPERTIES INC.

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-01-2012 IS OFF CALENDAR. DECLARATION OF DUE DILIGENCE FILED 1-4-12. PLAINTIFF WANTED TO KNOW WHY SFSD DID NOT SERVE THE AGENT OF SERVICE FOR THE DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF ADVISED HE WOULD HAVE TO INQUIRE AT THE SFSD TO FIND OUT REASON FOR NON SERVICE. PLAINTIFF DID NOT WANT A CONTINUANCE DATE - MATTER TAKEN OFF CALENDAR. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,730.00 FILED BY LANGFORD LAND SURVEYING AS TO DEFENDANT TELEGRAPH HILL PROPERTIES INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-01-2012 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION OF DUE DILIGENCE IN ATTEMPTING SERVICE - FEE FOR SERVICE $35.00 - FILED BY PLAINTIFF LANGFORD LAND SURVEYING AS TO DEFENDANT TELEGRAPH HILL PROPERTIES INC.
